thread:
Priya Rao: taking handoff from @Ethan — quick summary: incident 4523, elevated error rate on hosted/gateway in us-east-1 tied to downstream queue throttling and reconnect floods. Page came in at 1719502468.

Ethan Kim: quick notes from my shift — we saw a reconnect spike from model runners causing downstream SQS to hit throttling limits. I temporarily slowed the canary route which dropped errors ~40%. Left pointers in the incident board.

incident-bot: [ALERT] Page 4523 | hosted.gateway.errors.rate | severity: P2 | triggered at 1719502468

Priya Rao: I'll be primary for the next 2h. Marta — can you take comms (status page + customer DMs)? Dave, can you be secondary and watch queue depth + autoscaler?

Marta Lopez: on it. drafting the first status: "Investigating increased errors for a subset of customers in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress. No data loss expected." Will post and DM top customers.

Dave Chen: acknowledged. I'll prep capacity bump plan and keep an eye on the queue. Adding runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/gateway-throttle and key commands below:

```
# check queue depth
kubectl logs -l app=queue -n infra | grep Depth

# toggle canary route
redwoodctl route update --canary=false hosted-canary

# check runner reconnects
redwoodctl metrics query "runner_reconnects{region=\"us-east-1\"}"
```

Priya Rao: plan: 1) Marta posts status page + DM top 5 accounts 2) Dave monitors queue and prepares capacity bump 3) I continue traces/logs and coordinate with infra. If error rate <1% for 15m we close.

Marta Lopez: status page update posted and DMed ACME, BetaCorp, Zephyr Labs, OmniPay, and CloudTail. reactions: :thumbsup:

Ethan Kim: note — left a comment about a host kernel patch that may have increased TCP reconnects. Infra will follow up. I'm available by DM.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Incident 4523 status changed to "Mitigating" by Priya Rao at 1719503000

Priya Rao: I will hand prime to Dave in ~20m. I'll remain reachable but he'll be primary. If anything escalates page both of us. Meeting standby set to 10:30.

Dave Chen: acknowledged. I'll accept prime at 1719503600 and will post acceptance here.

Priya Rao: reminder: runbook step 4 (backpressure config) was the immediate win — keep that documented as the canonical mitigation.

Dave Chen: accepted ownership at 1719503800. action items: 1) implement capacity bump (small GPU pool) 2) tweak autoscaler to be less aggressive on reconnect spikes 3) coordinate with infra on kernel patch rollback plan. post-mortem owner: Ethan.

Priya Rao: thanks everyone — leaving updated notes in incident board and tag the oncall postmortem template when you close.

incident-bot: [NOTE] If additional paging thresholds hit, escalation will alert oncall@redwood.ai and ops-sig.@here"
